g.text: Exploratory display. Topics shown: 15 of 53, chosen by max − min of the decade means across the 6 decades with ≥ 10 works; full statistics in topic_stats.csv. Raw percentages, no per-row scaling. Hatched = fewer than 5 works (not shown); "sparse" = 5–9 works,

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: descriptive only. A difference between decades is not a tested change. Representative editions · works equal-weighted · decade = adopted year (British Drama; Annals only as fallback) · 53 included topics as share of all words (not renormalised)
